web.q: Find individual angel investors, venture funds, family offices and crypto/Web3 companies publicly stating they are actively investing, deploying capital, writing checks, seeking founder pitches or making strategic investments. Include recent first-person statements, cheque size if stated, stage, sector, date and original source.

Find individuals and companies publicly looking to acquire, buy, merge with, or acquire-hire Web3, crypto, blockchain or software projects, protocols, products, codebases or teams. Only explicit buyer intent and original dated sources.

Find people and companies offering equity investment, taking equity stakes, seeking co-founders, strategic investors or joint ventures with early-stage technology and Web3 projects. Capture exact terms if public.

Find active hiring posts from Web3 and technology companies and founders seeking developers, engineers, founders, business development, growth, community and operations talent. Prioritise recent original posts and job pages.
Find companies and individuals seeking Web3 partnerships, integrations, co-builders, distribution partners, ecosystem projects or strategic collaborations. Require evidence of an active ask.

Search public X posts and profiles on x.com and twitter.com for founders, angels, VCs, funds and companies stating they are investing in Web3 or crypto projects, open to pitches, deploying capital or writing checks. Return original post URLs and dates.

Search public Telegram channel pages and indexed t.me messages for first-person announcements from individuals or companies actively investing, offering funding, buying or acquiring Web3 projects, offering equity, hiring, or seeking strategic partnerships. Return the original public message URL where available, the poster or organisation, exact stated intent and date. Do not return generic channel directories or private content.
Search public Farcaster and Warpcast casts for individuals and companies seeking projects to fund, acquire, hire, partner with or take equity in. Include original cast URLs and dated evidence.

Search public Reddit posts and communities for first-person requests from investors, buyers, founders and companies looking to fund, acquire, hire or partner with Web3 projects. Include original permalink and date.

Find company websites, venture portfolio pages, acquisition pages and public announcements showing current investment mandates, strategic acquisition activity, startup programmes or open calls for projects. Include official sources and dates.
